methods.calendar: full declared DEV days rate; actual complete 30-day buckets, no window selection; perwindow illustrative N and future days are descriptive not forecasts
methods.component: Union same UTC signal day and transitive overlaps of actual plus causal reference occupation; open end +infinity; analyze component closed means and preserve open blockers
methods.counterexample: Synthetic chained overlapping intervals merge to one; never count raw trades as independent
methods.power: ceil(((z(1-.05/7)+z(.8))*sigma/(mu_alternative-mu_null))**2). Show original 5bps gap implies H0<=0/H1=5 or H0<=5/H1=10; H0<=5/H1=5 has no finite N
methods.sigma: Unbiased sample SD of finite completed component mean trade-net-bps, no old total/PF/WR recomputation
